user.title: Add Magic Switchbot
user.description: How do you want to add your device?

pick_device.title: Pick a Magic Switchbot
pick_device.description: {count} device(s) discovered via Bluetooth (including ESPHome proxies).

data_description.password: The PIN set in the MagicSwitchBot app (the app calls it a password). Leave empty if the device has no PIN.

manual.title: Enter the MAC address
manual.description: Type the Bluetooth MAC address of the device, e.g. AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.

data_description.password: The PIN set in the MagicSwitchBot app (the app calls it a password). Leave empty if the device has no PIN.
The PIN set in the MagicSwitchBot app (the app calls it a password). Leave empty if the device has no PIN.

reauth_confirm.title: Magic Switchbot PIN
reauth_confirm.description: **{name}** ({address}) rejected the PIN. Enter the PIN set in the MagicSwitchBot app, or leave the field empty if you removed it. The device must be in range so that the PIN can be checked.

reconfigure.title: Device PIN
reconfigure.description: What do you want to do? Before you continue, close the MagicSwitchBot app on your phone: the device accepts only one Bluetooth connection at a time and must be in range.

menu_options.reconfigure_password: Enter the PIN changed in the app (saved in Home Assistant only)
menu_options.change_pin: Set or change the PIN on the device
menu_options.remove_pin: Remove the PIN from the device

reconfigure_password.title: PIN changed in the app
reconfigure_password.description: Enter the PIN currently set for **{name}** ({address}) in the MagicSwitchBot app, or leave the field empty if the device has no PIN. Home Assistant only saves it; nothing changes on the device. The PIN is checked on the device before it is saved.

change_pin.title: Set or change the PIN
change_pin.description: Home Assistant sets the new PIN on **{name}** ({address}), checks that the device accepts it and then saves it. Use the new PIN in the MagicSwitchBot app from now on.

data_description.new_pin: Exactly 6 digits, as in the MagicSwitchBot app.

remove_pin.title: Remove the PIN
remove_pin.description: Home Assistant removes the PIN from **{name}** ({address}) and checks that the device no longer requires it. Anyone within Bluetooth range will then be able to control the device with the MagicSwitchBot app.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the device. Check that it is in range of a connectable Bluetooth adapter or ESPHome proxy.
error.invalid_pin_format: The PIN must have exactly 6 digits.
error.current_pin_rejected: The device rejected the PIN saved in Home Assistant, so the PIN was not changed. First enter the current PIN (Enter the PIN changed in the app).
error.pin_not_changed: The device did not accept the change. The PIN on the device is unchanged.
error.pin_unverified: The command was sent, but the result could not be checked. Check in the MagicSwitchBot app whether the PIN changed. If Home Assistant later reports a rejected PIN, enter the current one.

abort.already_configured: This Magic Switchbot is already configured.
abort.no_devices_found: No Magic Switchbot devices were discovered.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The PIN was accepted and saved.
abort.pin_changed: The new PIN is set on the device and saved in Home Assistant.
abort.pin_removed: The PIN was removed from the device.

init.title: Magic Switchbot options
init.description: Choose which entities to create and the BLE parameters.

data_description.retry_count: How many times a command is retried over a new connection when the device does not answer (0-10). A push is not retried once the command was sent.
data_description.command_timeout: Total time limit for a command, including all retries, in seconds (30-120). A single connection attempt can take up to 20 seconds.

command_failed.message: The device {address} did not confirm the command.

invalid_auth.message: The device {address} rejected the PIN. Enter the correct PIN in the reauthentication prompt.

device_not_found.message: {address} is not reachable through the Bluetooth stack. Check that an ESPHome Bluetooth proxy is in range and that the device is powered.
